features.name: Group Karaoke Rooms
features.description: Host creates a karaoke room (big-screen YouTube player + live queue + join QR); guests scan QR on phones, get anonymous Better Auth sessions + nickname, search YouTube (Data API v3, "karaoke"-biased, results persisted to D1 song/search_log tables), add songs to a shared queue. Live state (queue/playback/roster) lives in a per-room raw Durable Object (KaraokeRoom, SQLite storage, WS hibernation — @cloudflare/actors was spiked and rejected as immature); D1 keeps durable room records + played-song history. Host controls play/pause/skip/volume/reorder (dnd-kit); reorder rights gated by per-room allowGuestReorder toggle; rooms auto-close after 1h idle via a DO alarm.
features.evidence: Phases 1-6 complete 2026-07-16. Plan plans/group-karaoke.html (reviewed, 4 decisions). Verification .brain/features/group-karaoke/verifications/2026-07-16.md PASS (11/11 golden steps, friendly error path, 0 app-origin errors). verify-done: typecheck PASS, 400 unit tests PASS (33 files), e2e smoke 2/2, build PASS (prod+preview), harness-check 11/11. Post-review (2026-07-16): all Greptile threads resolved incl. P1 r3593261839 (guest-reorder made single-writer — DO owns live+D1, client WS-only; dead tRPC/repo/schema removed); 401 tests. PR #1 merged to main. Feature wall-clock ~1h 55m (first commit → merge).

features.name: Karaoke UI/UX Overhaul
features.description: Strip all SaaS-boilerplate surfaces and reskin the app with a karaoke-first 'dark night-club stage' design system (pink→gold gradient accent, Google Fonts display face, 10-foot TV type scale on /room). New playful landing (hero + enter-room-code + host CTA), slim host-hub dashboard, reskinned auth, host TV screen (lobby state, persistent QR, added-by queue chips, celebrations) and guest phone flow (nickname spinner, Verse-style search/add, tap-based move-up/move-to-top reorder, position bar). Join/add pop sounds behind host mute toggle. Both themes kept (dark default). No singer rotation, no audio normalization. Plan: plans/karaoke-ui-overhaul.html (reviewed 2026-07-16, round 1, all 5 decisions answered).
features.evidence: Shipped 2026-07-16. Phases 1-6a complete (7 commits f44c013..915e2fd + this ship). Plan plans/karaoke-ui-overhaul.html (reviewed round 1, 5 decisions). features.name: TV Beta Feedback Polish
features.description: Beta-session feedback pass on the TV screen (/room/:code). Lobby becomes horizontal two-column (QR hero left, roster right, no page scroll at 1080p). Playing state maximizes the video: left column video + smaller wrapping title (56px→~36px, 2-line clamp); right rail (~300-320px) stacks participants / queue (heading 36px→~22px) / QR at bottom. TV play/skip removed entirely — phone Controls tab is the only playback surface. 'You're up' overlay: 100% opacity, 5s, animated exit. Sounds gamified: multi-note synth jingles + 'your turn' fanfare, no audio assets. Corner QR stays lobby-only. Plan: plans/tv-beta-feedback.html (reviewed 2026-07-16 round 1, 3 decisions answered).
